name: echo-smear
title: Echo Smear
description: Attachment snippet, no markup of its own: apply it to the host's element and drive it from the host timeline with the recipe in the file. Distance-adaptive streak — records each element's real trajectory (position, rotation, scale, opacity), then trails time-offset copies behind it in proportion to its speed, combined by brightest pixel, so fast moves smear and slow ones stay sharp; spinning edges stay smooth
